rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an argument or explanation that is convincing.

example.english: This explanation is cogent, so everyone accepted it.
example.traditional: 呢個解釋好有說服力，大家都接受咗。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaai2 sik1 hou2 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 zip3 sau6 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that the reasoning makes sense or is logically consistent, even if it is not especially persuasive.

example.english: Your explanation is cogent, but it may not persuade people.
example.traditional: 你咁樣解釋係講得通嘅，但未必可以說服人。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 gaai2 sik1 hai6 gong2 dak1 tung1 ge3 daan6 mei6 bit1 ho2 ji5 seoi3 fuk6 jan4

rows.note: Use this when the argument is convincing because it is supported by clear reasons and evidence.

example.english: They put forward a cogent proposal at the meeting, and it was eventually approved.
example.traditional: 佢喺會議上提出一個有理有據嘅方案，最後獲得通過。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 tai4 ceot1 jat1 go3 jau5 lei5 jau5 geoi3 ge3 fong1 on3 zeoi3 hau6 wok6 dak1 tung1 gwo3
